issues.title: Missing Per-Artifact Spec Files
issues.why: The module references 79 external spec files (e.g., 01-check-spec-cross-links.md) which are not provided in the context. An AI coder cannot implement the toolchain logic (the actual script behaviors) without these individual specs.
issues.fix: Include the content of the referenced NN-*.md files in the provided context or merge them into a single implementation-ready document.

issues.title: Delegated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-T-29 explicitly delegates per-script logic to external files. Without these, the AI has no Given/When/Then criteria for the actual script behaviors (e.g., how fuzzy matching works in slot 12).
issues.fix: In-line the core GWT criteria for each slot into the Slot Delegation Map in §97.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking Implementation Ambiguity
issues.why: R2 requires retries on JSONDecodeError to handle 'torn reads', but doesn't specify if this applies to all readers or just specific slots, and lacks a code example for the retry logic.
issues.fix: Add the normative code snippet for R2 (read_json_with_retry) to the §00 Resilience section as mandated by AC-T-32.
